These delicious products come to you as warm loaves via the conveyor belt. You place these neatly in the crate. And not only breads! You also work with mini rolls of dough. You can fill these with ice cream. Treat yourself to something good and choose your new job at Goedhart Hedel! The name actually says it all. ;-)

Where will you work
Goedhart in hedel is a nice company to work in. The atmosphere is outstanding. Isn't that great? Together with your colleagues you provide the best production in the Netherlands! In the breaks you can also enjoy a delicious piece of bread! You can buy this delicious bread with a great discount. Do you want to grow? That is certainly possible at Goedhart in Hedel. You can become an operator.
